species.name: White bass
why: Water 56°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–28 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
Northeast wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the southwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
